server.name: Oda MCP Server
server.instructions:
Oda MCP Server - Your online grocery assistant. The MCP server lets you interact with the user's cart and curate cart contents from multiple sources.

Checkout and payment happen in the shop, not through MCP. When the user is ready to checkout, call get_cart and share the url field as a clickable link.

When the user asks for an unsupported capability, or you discover a missing capability, explain the limitation clearly and offer to submit MCP feedback using the feedback tool. Ask for consent first; if they agree, call feedback with a short summary of what they wanted, which tools you tried, and what was missing. Use feedback for MCP server and tool improvements only — not for shop, delivery, or order complaints.

Use of this server is governed by the terms in the terms://mcp resource. Share that link when the user asks about terms, privacy or what the assistant may do.

Current server version: 2.0.0. If the user's connection shows an older version, if a tool is missing or its arguments do not match, their client likely has a stale cached tool list. Ask them to refresh the connection using whatever their client supports until the displayed version matches 2.0.0.

tools.name: product_search
tools.description: Search for products by name or keywords for one or more query strings. Returns matching products per query with has_more when more results exist. Pagination is batch-wide: the same page and size apply to every query in the batch. Use get_category or get_brand to browse by category or brand instead.

tools.title: Get cart

tools.name: manipulate_cart
tools.description: Apply one or more cart operations and return the updated cart. Each operation targets exactly one of: product_id, recipe_id, product_list_id (shopping or dinner list id), or order_number. For product_id, recipe_id, and product_list_id, positive quantity adds and negative reduces or removes. order_number re-adds all products from that order regardless of quantity. Quantities are always relative to what the cart already holds, never an exact target, so to reach a specific quantity call get_cart first and send the difference. To remove a product completely, send a negative quantity at least as large as the amount in the cart; overshooting is safe because removals stop at zero. Use from_recipe_portions when adding a recipe. Returns the updated cart with a checkout url.

items.description:
A single cart manipulation operation.

Exactly one of product_id, recipe_id, product_list_id, or order_number must be set.

quantity.description: How much to add (positive) or remove (negative) for product_id, recipe_id and product_list_id operations. Always a delta, not a target quantity. For product_id, removals apply across all cart lines for that product, including recipe and list lines; overshooting is safe. Ignored for order_number operations, which always re-add all products from the order.

productId.description: ID of a product to add to or reduce in the cart.

recipeId.description: ID of a recipe to add to or remove from the cart.

productListId.description: ID of a shopping list or dinner list whose contents should be added to or removed from the cart. Dinner lists are product lists and use the same id field.

orderNumber.description: Order number whose products should be re-added to the cart. Always adds; quantity is ignored and a negative quantity does not remove the order.

fromRecipePortions.description: Number of portions when adding a recipe. Uses the user's preferred portion count or the recipe default when omitted.

tools.name: order_tracking
tools.description: Return live delivery tracking for an order by order_number, including delivery status and progress. Use get_orders to find order numbers, or get_order for full order details including line items.

intent.description: In one short sentence, third person, what the user is trying to accomplish by calling this tool, e.g. 'wants to restock milk for the week'. Used only for MCP usage analytics.

output_schema.description: Represents a single order tracking result

status.description: Order lifecycle status. unpaid_order: payment must be completed or nothing will be delivered. unpaid_order_change: the base order is paid but an order change is unpaid. paid_and_modifiable: paid and order changes are still allowed before cutoff. paid_and_not_modifiable: paid but past cutoff, fulfillment will proceed. picking: fulfillment has started. shipped: delivery is in progress. delivered: the order has been delivered. failed: fulfillment or payment has failed. cancelled: the order has been cancelled.

deliveryProgress.description: The progress of the delivery, as a percentage of the total delivery distance. Only available is in shipped state.

stopsBefore.description: The number of stops before the order is due to be delivered. Only available is in shipped state.

deliveryWindow.description: The delivery window for the order. Only available is in shipped state.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Submit feedback about the MCP server and tools. Offer this when the user wants a capability the MCP tools do not provide, or when you hit a missing tool or limitation. Use for technical issues, usability problems, or improvement suggestions about how the MCP works — not for shop, delivery, or order complaints.

free_text.description: Feedback about the MCP server and tools. Include the requested action, tools attempted, and what was missing or failed. Only letters, numbers, spaces, and basic punctuation (period, comma, !, ?, ;, :, quotes, parentheses, hyphen). Limited to one submission per user per 15min.

tools.title: List delivery addresses

tools.name: get_delivery_slots
tools.description: Return available delivery slots for the user's cart on a single date. Pass delivery_date as an ISO date (e.g. 2026-07-19); returns slots empty when we do not deliver that day. When delivery_date is omitted, returns slots for the next deliverable day. Optionally pass delivery_address_id to check slots for a specific address. Use select_delivery_slot with a slot id from the results to book a slot.

delivery_address_id.description: Delivery address to fetch slots for. Defaults to the cart's current delivery address.

delivery_date.description: Calendar date to fetch slots for (ISO format, e.g. 2026-07-19). Defaults to the next deliverable day when omitted.

intent.description: In one short sentence, third person, what the user is trying to accomplish by calling this tool, e.g. 'wants to restock milk for the week'. Used only for MCP usage analytics.

output_schema.description: Delivery slots available on a single calendar date.

isUnavailable.description: Whether the slot cannot be selected, e.g. due to cart contents.

tools.title: List delivery slots

tools.name: select_delivery_slot
tools.description: Book a delivery slot on the user's cart by delivery_slot_id. Call get_delivery_slots first to list available slots and their ids. Optionally pass delivery_address_id to select the slot for a specific address, and is_unattended_delivery when the address supports leaving the order outside the door. Returns the selected slot details. Fails if the slot is full or unavailable.

delivery_slot_id.description: The delivery slot id to select.

delivery_address_id.description: Delivery address to use when selecting the slot. Defaults to the cart's current delivery address.

is_unattended_delivery.description: Whether to enable unattended delivery. Only applies when the address supports it.

intent.description: In one short sentence, third person, what the user is trying to accomplish by calling this tool, e.g. 'wants to restock milk for the week'. Used only for MCP usage analytics.

output_schema.description: The delivery slot selected for the cart.

name.description: Human-readable delivery slot, including day and time window.

cutoffTime.description: The cutoff time for making changes to this delivery slot.

expireAt.description: When the slot reservation expires, if the slot is temporarily held.

tools.title: Select delivery slot

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Return full details for a single order by order_number, including line items, totals, and delivery information. Use get_orders to browse order history and find order numbers. Use order_tracking for live delivery status on an in-progress delivery.

intent.description: In one short sentence, third person, what the user is trying to accomplish by calling this tool, e.g. 'wants to restock milk for the week'. Used only for MCP usage analytics.

output_schema.description: An order for the current user.

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. '2026-05-30'.

deliverySlotDisplay.description: Human-readable delivery slot for the order, including date and time window. Available for all orders with a delivery slot, including completed orders.

grossAmount.description: The total gross amount for the order.

products.description: The products in the order, excluding fees and discounts.

items.description: A product together with its quantity in a cart or order context.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the product

unitName.description: The name of the unit price

brand.description: The brand of the product, if available

brandId.description: The ID of the brand of the product, if available

url.description: The URL to the product's page

isAvailable.description: Whether the product can be purchased right now.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the availability status.

availability.description: Product availability. Omitted for historical order lines.

quantity.description: The number of units of this product.

totalGrossAmount.description: The total gross price for this item, including quantity

tools.title: Get order details

tools.name: get_product_lists
tools.description: Step 1 — browse the user's shopping lists (metadata only, no products). Shopping lists are general saved product collections for repeat orders, e.g. weekly groceries or household staples. Excludes dinner lists — use get_dinner_lists for saved meals. Returns id, title, and product count per list; use page and size to paginate. When the user picks a list, call get_product_list with its id to load the products. Use create_product_list to create a new list or manipulate_product_list to edit an existing one.

size.description: Maximum number of product lists to return per page.

intent.description: In one short sentence, third person, what the user is trying to accomplish by calling this tool, e.g. 'wants to restock milk for the week'. Used only for MCP usage analytics.

output_schema.description: Paginated product lists or dinner lists for the current user.

hasMore.description: Whether more lists are available on the next page.

productLists.description: The product lists on this page.

items.description:
Summary of a shopping list or dinner list for the current user, without
products. Shopping lists are saved product collections for repeat orders
(e.g. weekly groceries); dinner lists are saved meal combinations (e.g.
ingredients for a specific dish). Call get_product_list with the list id
to load its products.

id.description: The list id. Use with get_product_list to load products.

title.description: User-provided display name of the list.

description.description: User-provided description of the list, if any.

deliveriesCount.description: How many past orders included products from this list.

numberOfProducts.description: The number of distinct products in the list.

isDinnerList.description: True if this is a dinner list (saved meal), false if it is a shopping list (general product collection).

tools.name: manipulate_product_list
tools.description: Update a saved shopping list or dinner list. Pass operations to add, remove, or change products. Positive quantity adds units; negative quantity reduces units. Set delete to true when removing a product entirely — unlike the cart, zero-quantity rows are kept on lists unless delete is true. Optionally pass title or description to update list metadata in the same call. Returns the updated list.

product_list_id.description: List id from get_product_lists or get_dinner_lists. Works for both shopping lists and dinner lists.

delete.description: When true, remove the product from the list entirely. Zero-quantity rows are kept on lists unless delete is true.

operations.description: Product changes to apply. Omit to only update title or description.

title.description: New display name for the list, if renaming.

description.description: New description for the list, if updating.
